skills.name: mbse-systems-engineering
skills.description: Reason through system behavior, cross-discipline tradeoffs, and lifecycle decisions: understand the problem, question assumptions, synthesize evidence, and explain engineering recommendations.

skills.name: mbse-system-concept
skills.description: Frame an engineering problem, develop or explain system concepts, and compare ways to achieve stakeholder outcomes within feasibility constraints.

skills.name: mbse-conops
skills.description: Understand, explain, develop, or revise how a system will operate across stakeholders, boundaries, operating conditions, and lifecycle support.

skills.name: mbse-operational-scenarios
skills.description: Explore or explain operational scenarios, then develop actor actions, system responses, modes, exchanges, exceptions, and recovery when a scenario artifact is needed.

skills.name: mbse-requirements
skills.description: Interpret stakeholder needs, question and reconcile engineering requirements, and develop or review their sources, acceptance conditions, and traceability.

skills.name: mbse-architecture
skills.description: Reason about system behavior and structure, explain architectural choices, and develop or review functions, allocations, interfaces, and design trades.

skills.name: mbse-verification-evidence
skills.description: Reason about what evidence can establish an engineering claim; plan or assess requirements verification, stakeholder validation, and configuration-controlled results.

skills.name: mbse-baseline-review
skills.description: Challenge and explain an engineering baseline or change, examining system reasoning, consistency, allocations, risk controls, evidence, and decision readiness.

skills.name: mbse-aerospace
skills.description: Understand and reason through aircraft or space system questions, connecting mission behavior, architecture, safety, development assurance, and program evidence.

skills.name: mbse-defense
skills.description: Understand and reason through defense system and acquisition questions, connecting mission threads, organizations, architecture, safety, sustainment, and decision evidence.

skills.name: mbse-automotive
skills.description: Understand and reason through vehicle-system behavior, connecting driver and operating context, E/E architecture, functional safety, SOTIF, cybersecurity, and lifecycle evidence.

skills.name: mbse-medical-device
skills.description: Understand and reason through medical-device system questions, connecting intended use, clinical workflow, patient/user risk, architecture, software lifecycle, and regulatory evidence.

skills.name: mbse-electronic-systems
skills.description: Understand and reason through ASIC, FPGA, SoC, and control-electronics problems, connecting physical behavior, HW/SW interfaces, implementation choices, verification, and assurance.
